description: Start saved tests now against the project's agent. Each test becomes one run; runs started together form one batch. Returns the batch_id and the run number of each started test, and the reason for any that could not start. Runs take minutes: follow them with list_runs and the batch_id. Pass a category to run a test category, as Test Lab does: every test in it, or the tests you list, named after the category in Test Results. Uses conversation credits and calls the agent, so run what the user asked for, not more.

category.description: A regular test category (id or name, as list_test_categories shows them): the launch is a category run named after it. Without tests, every test of the category runs.
category.title: Category

label.description: What Test Results calls this launch.
label.title: Label

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

tests.description: The ids of the saved tests to run, as list_tests shows them. Leave it out with a category to run every test of the category.
tests.title: Tests

name: run_tests
